intro.title: Omnichannel Orders Pipeline
intro.subtitle: Track incoming WhatsApp, phone and app orders across Received, Preparing, Ready and Delivered stages

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 7, Part 1: Managing Omnichannel Orders Pipeline. Fulfilling remote customer orders from WhatsApp, mobile apps, and telephone orders keeps your pharmacy responsive and organized.
Go to Orders. The pipeline dashboard organizes orders across key fulfillment stages: Received, Preparing, Ready, and Delivered.
Channel origin badges identify order sources instantly, distinguishing WhatsApp chats, eRetail web carts, and direct phone calls.
Open an order to inspect requested medicines and customer notes. Advance the status to Preparing for dispensary packing, then Ready for pickup.
Complete the order by generating an instant POS tax bill or marking it Delivered upon home delivery. In Part 2, we fulfill Promise Orders!

outro.takeaway: Omnichannel Orders Pipeline: Fulfill remote pharmacy orders systematically across Received, Preparing, Ready and Delivered stages.
